map.截面回转半径（本页代码口径）：r=√(I÷A)（m，I 惯性矩 m⁴、A 截面积: Section radius of gyration (per this page's code): r = √(I÷A) (m; I moment of inertia in m⁴, A area in m²); linked values: r(mm) = r×1000, recomputed moment of inertia = r²×A (m⁴), r².
